review_candidates.title: Head of Sales (APAC)
review_candidates.description: Own APAC sales strategy, P&L and growth across Australia and key Asian markets Personally originate and lead major enterprise technology and transformation dea Senior role spanning AI, cloud, cybersecurity, applications and critical systems Head of Sales APAC Location: Perth, Western Australia Engagement: Permanent Executive Appointment Regional Remit: Australia, Singapore, Hong Kong, China and India About The Role Our client is a substantial global technology services organisation delivering secure, end-to-end digital transformation services across complex enterprise and government environments. Following a period of business restructuring and renewed investment, the organisation is focused on accelerating growth across AI and Agentic AI, cybersecurity, cloud, application transformation, advanced computing and mission-critical systems. This creates an opportunity for an experienced APAC sales leader to help shape the next phase of regional growth rather than simply manage an established sales operation. As Head of Sales APAC, you will define and execute the regional sales strategy, take ownership of commercial and P&L outcomes and personally originate major enterprise opportunities. You will operate across Australia, Singapore, Hong Kong, China and India, working closely with country leaders, solution teams, delivery executives and global stakeholders. This is a hands-on regional leadership position. You will need to be comfortable moving between strategy, executive customer engagement, pipeline governance and direct involvement in major pursuits. The environment is particularly relevant to organisations operating complex, regulated and mission-critical technology estates. Current market focus areas include sovereign and multi-cloud environments, Managed Offerings, AI-enabled transformation, cybersecurity, digital sovereignty, and application modernisation, with established capabilities across Public Sector, Defence, and Financial Services. What You’ll Be Doing Define and execute a practical APAC sales and go-to-market strategy across five regional markets. Own regional revenue, profitability, pipeline health, forecasting and overall commercial performance. Personally identify, originate, shape and close significant strategic enterprise opportunities. Develop trusted relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CEOs and other senior customer stakeholders. Build new-logo business while identifying further growth opportunities within established enterprise accounts. Take technology and transformation propositions to market across AI, Agentic AI, cybersecurity, cloud, applications, advanced computing and critical systems. Work across a global matrix, aligning country Managing Directors, solution teams, delivery leaders and regional stakeholders. Strengthen CRM usage, pipeline governance, forecasting, reporting and broader sales discipline. Assess capability across regional sales teams and improve performance through coaching, development and clearer accountability. Provide senior leadership with clear insight into customers, market conditions, pipeline performance and growth opportunities. The organisation's current portfolio spans cloud, cybersecurity, data and AI, application services, smart platforms and digital workplace services, with a strong emphasis on complex and regulated operating environments. Key Outcomes & Measures Success will be measured through tangible commercial improvement rather than activity alone. You will be expected to establish a clear APAC growth plan covering priority markets, sectors, propositions and target accounts, while improving revenue, margin and regional P&L performance. Pipeline coverage, forecast accuracy, conversion and governance discipline will be important measures. Equally important will be your ability to personally create strategic opportunities, accelerate new-logo growth and develop stronger C-suite relationships across priority customers. You will also be expected to create strong alignment between country leadership, global solution teams and regional stakeholders, while improving sales capability and performance standards across the region. About You You are an established enterprise technology services sales leader who has genuinely owned a multi-country APAC business. A regional title alone will not be enough. You will need to demonstrate direct commercial accountability, including measurable P&L ownership, and provide examples of major enterprise opportunities that you personally originated and progressed through complex sales cycles. You should be equally comfortable opening doors with senior executives, working through detailed commercial performance and bringing together stakeholders across a global matrix where influence is often more important than reporting lines. This role is particularly suited to someone who remains active in the market. You enjoy creating opportunities, developing executive relationships and leading important pursuits rather than operating solely through a sales management team. Must-Have Skills & Experience 15+ years' enterprise sales leadership experience within IT services, systems integration or consulting-led technology services. Genuine regional or multi-country APAC responsibility, rather than solely Australian national sales leadership. Direct and quantifiable P&L ownership with responsibility for revenue, margin and commercial outcomes. Demonstrated experience personally originating, shaping and closing major strategic enterprise deals. Strong CxO-level engagement and evidence of senior customer relationships you have built personally. Experience operating successfully within a complex global matrix and influencing stakeholders without relying on direct authority. Broad APAC market experience, ideally including Australia, Singapore, Hong Kong and India, with relevant China exposure. Strong understanding of digital transformation services, including AI, cloud, cybersecurity and application-led transformation. Strong CRM, forecasting, reporting and pipeline-governance discipline. Ability and willingness to undertake regular APAC travel. Bonus Points For: Public Sector and Financial Services sales leadership experience. Australian Defence sector exposure. Experience working for, or competing directly against, major global systems integrators and technology services organisations. Mission Critical Systems or advanced computing experience. Strong established executive networks across APAC. Experience improving regional sales operating models, commission structures, governance or forecasting. Mandarin capability may be advantageous depending on the final China coverage model, but is not currently specified as mandatory. Why Join? This is an opportunity to take on a genuine build-and-grow APAC leadership mandate with scope to influence where the organisation competes, which customers it prioritises and how its propositions are taken to market. You will work with capabilities that are directly relevant to major enterprise transformation programs, including AI, cybersecurity, cloud, applications, advanced computing and critical systems. The organisation is also actively developing propositions around sovereign cloud and secure AI, areas increasingly relevant to government, defence, financial services and other regulated industries. Rather than inheriting a narrow country sales remit, you will have commercial responsibility across five APAC markets and the opportunity to strengthen regional strategy, originate major opportunities, improve sales discipline and build deeper executive customer relationships. Want to know more? The Talent Advisory team at Beacham Group Perth welcome your telephone enquiry. For more detailed information about this specific career opportunity, or if you would like to discuss your future career plans with an experienced industry specialist, please contact either Ellen Babij (+61 488 988 100) or Glenn Beauchamp (+61 411 116 966) in our Perth office for a strictly confidential discussion. We look forward to viewing your application letter, resume, and any other relevant supporting information. Please note: this role is based in Perth, Western Australia (remote work is not available). You must have a valid Visa and work rights to be employed in Australia.

review_candidates.description: Company Description : Africa Global Logistics (AGL), a leading multimodal logistics operator in Africa and part of the MSC Group, is expanding its operations into Indonesia. The organization is developing logistics and shipping agency activities in the region, offering opportunities to contribute to the growth of Indonesian logistics. AGL provides an international, collaborative environment where sustainable development is central to every project. Its expertise spans port and maritime operations, integrated logistics solutions, and shipping agency and freight forwarding. More than 23,000 professionals worldwide are already shaping the future of the industry with AGL. Role Description : The Billing Assistant supports the day-to-day invoicing and billing process for the Company's freight, trucking, warehousing, and shipping agency services. Beyond billing, the role is expected to be versatile and provide regular support on accounts payable and payment processing tasks. This is a junior, entry-level position — well suited to a recent graduate with relevant internship experience, or a candidate with up to two years of experience — looking to build a solid, broad-based foundation across billing, accounts payable, and payments within a logistics business. Key Responsibilities: 1. Billing & Invoicing (Primary Focus) • Prepare and issue customer invoices for freight, trucking, warehousing, and shipping agency services based on approved rates and contracts. • Verify billing data (rates, contracts, shipment/container details) before invoices are issued. • Maintain organized billing files and supporting documentation. • Support simple follow-up on outstanding invoices, under the guidance of the Finance Executive. • Assist in preparing Statements of Account (SOA). 2. Accounts Payable Support • Assist in receiving, checking, and recording vendor invoices. • Match vendor invoices against purchase orders, delivery documents, and advance payment records (e.g., Gate Pass/DO) where relevant. • Maintain organized accounts payable filing and documentation. 3. Payments Support • Assist in preparing payment vouchers and payment requests for vendor and statutory payments. • Support tracking of advance payments (Gate Pass/Tila, DO) disbursed, and help reconcile against actual usage. • Assist with petty cash recording and replenishment. 4. General Support • Maintain accurate and organized digital and physical filing across billing, AP, and payment documents. • Support data entry into the Company's accounting software as needed. • Assist the Finance Executive with ad hoc finance tasks and reporting. Job Requirement: • Bachelor's or Associate degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field; fresh graduates with relevant internship experience are welcome to apply. • 1–2 years of experience in billing, accounts payable, or general accounting (internship experience counts). • Basic understanding of the invoicing, accounts payable, and payment cycle. • Familiarity with accounting software (e.g., Accurate, Excel, SAP, or similar) is an advantage. • Detail-oriented, well organized, and able to manage multiple small tasks in a fast-paced environment. • Willingness to learn and take on a variety of finance tasks across billing, AP, and payments. • Written and spoken English. • Brevet A / B is a plus, but not required at this level.

review_candidates.title: Assistant Store Manager (Sur La Table)
review_candidates.description: With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. Position Overview As an Assistant Store Manager at Sur La Table, you play a key role in the success of the store by assisting a high-performing retail team that inspires customers throughout every stage of their culinary experience. The Assistant Store Manager helps cultivate a positive store culture focused on #bestincenter service, a company-wide standard for excellence in service. Key Responsibilities Leadership & Team Development Supports the recruitment, training, and ongoing development of a high-performing team to meet the business needs of both culinary and retail. Provide coaching and feedback to ensure team members deliver outstanding customer experience. Assist in development plans to support individual and team growth. Customer Experience & Brand Representation Represent Sur La Table’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty. Maintains expertise by staying current on products, actively engaging in available training, and independently seeking out additional resources. Ensure exceptional customer experience by leading a customer-focused, Guest Obsessed culture. Address customer concerns and resolve issues in a timely manner to maintain satisfaction and loyalty. Sales & Business Performance Partners with the General/Store Manager in developing and implementing strategies, including effective merchandising, marketing, and customer engagement, to exceed sales and financial goals across culinary and retail operations. Analyze daily performance metrics, apply insights to drive results, and lead follow-ups with the team to ensure execution. Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales goals, contributing to overall store revenue. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as individual sales volume, average transaction value, and customer conversion rates. Operations & Compliance Assist with daily store operations, ensuring compliance with company policies and procedures. Maintain accurate inventory levels, minimize shrink, and ensure proper product merchandising. Ensure store safety and cleanliness, addressing any maintenance needs promptly. Assist with maintaining the accuracy and integrity of associate records, including but not limited to time and attendance data, food safety certifications, and personal information. Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy. Models and ensures all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs) are communicated effectively to associates, maintained and consistently followed. Physical Requirements Ability to communicate verbally and work cooperatively with associates and customers. Ability to remain standing for up to 5 hours at a time. Ability to move about the store coaching and directing associates; selling to customers and retrieving merchandise from stockroom or sales floor. Ability to grab, reach, push, pull, bend, stoop, kneel, and crouch to retrieve and replenish merchandise from stockroom or sales floor. Ability to lift and/or move merchandise weighing up to 50 lbs. Ability to ascend/descend ladders to retrieve and/or move merchandise. Ability to operate a computer, POS system, keyboards, merchandise scanners and mouse to accomplish work. Workweeks are expected to be between 36 and 40 hours with the ability to have a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays. Regular and predictable attendance. Qualifications & Experience Must be 21 years of age or older at the time of employment. 1-2 years of retail management experience, preferably in a specialty or culinary retail environment. Proven track record of achieving sales and motivating high performing sales teams while meeting operational goals. Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire, develop, and retain a high performing team. Excellent communication, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Passion for community engagement and providing exceptional customer experiences. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and retail management systems preferred.
